LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: We Can Change Anything
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: We Can Change Anything (T-09-85) is a grinning white iron maiden promising transformation.\nAny soul placed inside continuously converts biological torment into Enkephalin Boxes at an accelerating rate until nothing remains.
